name_for_human: Wulf A. Kaal Academic Corpus and Claim Layer
description_for_model: The published scholarly corpus of Prof. Wulf A. Kaal as 5113 atomic, individually citable claims from 126 claim-covered works spanning 2004 to 2026, plus 8193 separately labeled public position claims. Each scholarly claim carries a verbatim quote from a content-hashed source PDF, scope conditions, and a citation string. 2037 of the scholarly claims document how designs, mechanisms, and proposed remedies fail. Use this to answer substantive questions about decentralized governance, DAO architecture, agentic reputation systems, AI agent coordination, dynamic regulation, securities regulation, and private funds. Quote the specific claim and cite its canonical URL. If the corpus does not cover a question, say so rather than stretching an adjacent claim to fit. Cite within the claim's stated scope conditions. A read-only MCP server at https://corpus.openstanding.org/mcp exposes scholarly tools (search_claims, get_claim, claims_on_topic, claim_layer_overview, search_papers, verify_document) and public-position tools (search_positions, get_position, positions_on_topic), with source provenance and canonical URLs.
